notes.title: Map Drawing and Card Layout Update
notes.content:
New Features 🗺️ Map Drawing System
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758352/0b756b7cd20be2d6926e0277106b33bc66946cbf.png"]

Players can now annotate their journey with a fully-featured drawing system!

Key Features:

Drawing Tools - Draw directly on the map with customizable brush sizes and colors

Eraser Mode - Remove unwanted marks with adjustable eraser hardness

Persistent Annotations - All drawings are automatically saved per map and restored when revisiting

Undo/Redo Support - Made a mistake? Use undo/redo to perfect your annotations (up to 20 steps)

Drawing Modes - Toggle between Draw, Erase, and Navigation modes seamlessly


How to Use:

Click the pencil icon to enter drawing mode

Scroll to adjust brush size while drawing

Right-click or press ESC to exit drawing mode 
🎴 Card Layout Customization
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758352/591d41a27f071a217c26d2bae6e4ee9779eb90de.png"]

Take full control of your card display with extensive customization options!

Customizable Parameters:

Card Spacing & Width - Adjust how cards spread across your hand

Scale Settings - Control base card size, hover scale, and selected card scale

Position Offsets - Fine-tune vertical positioning for normal, middle, and hovered cards

Animation Timing - Adjust animation speed for card movements and hover effects

Rotation Controls - Customize card fan angle and rotation multiplier

Rainbow Arc Effect - Control the curve height of your card fan


Additional Features:

Settings persist per player profile

Reset to defaults option available

Real-time preview of changes 

  
Quality of Life Improvements
Drawing data is stored efficiently with automatic compression

Card layout changes apply immediately without restart

Both systems integrate seamlessly with existing UI elements


Note: The map drawing feature is designed to help players plan routes, mark important locations, or simply express creativity during their runs. All drawings are local to your profile and can be cleared at any time.

notes.title: 🌒 Moon’s Creed – Balance & Content Update V0.1
notes.content:
Our first major balance update is here.

This patch brings wide-scale adjustments to heroes, boons, and sets the groundwork for upcoming content. It’s all based on live data and community feedback, with the goal of making every build path feel more strategic and rewarding.

Let’s take a look at what’s changed.
What’s Next?
This patch marks the first wave of our large-scale rebalancing efforts for heroes and boons. But we’re just getting started.

Here's what’s coming up soon:

More Balance Updates:
 Additional adjustments to cards and boons will continue to roll out, refining the core gameplay experience based on live performance data and community feedback.


Element Card & Event Reworks:
 Expect refreshed versions of Element cards and Events—bringing both new mechanics and clarity improvements to existing content.


Expanded Content:
 We're working on extending your journey with more mid-run surprises, alternate paths, and enriched build options.

-Scarred: Fixed a critical issue that corrupted save files and killed the player.

Effects

-Fixed a bug with Reactive Cloak.

Quality of Life Improvements

-Character select screen now preloads videos.
-Implemented UI caching for cards.
-Implemented VFX caching for better performance.
-Fixed audio priority issues.

Achievements

-The "Win under 30 minutes" achievement is now working correctly.
-Fixed an issue with the Fire Boon achievement.


Keep the feedback coming!
Your input is invaluable! As we continue improving the game, feel free to share any issues or suggestions you may have. Enjoy playing!

notes.title: Moon's Creed - Early Access Release
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the Early Access release of our studio's first game, Moon's Creed!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2340510/

About the Game
Moon's Creed offers an experience where you build strategic decks using zodiac powers, battle against constellations corrupted by chaos, and change the fate of the cosmos. Strategic deck-building, boons from 12 zodiac signs, 3 different heroes, chaos rooms, and high replayability invite you to a new adventure every time!

Every game is unique! You can engage in challenging battles in Chaos Rooms, increase your power with Astral Boons, and discover new strategies on randomly generated maps. With full modding support, you can create your own content and enjoy endless replayability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758352/b45a184648eba5742166b815ff5f29c4e499f11c.gif

Early Access Process
After a development period of more than a year and a half, this stage is an important milestone for us to fully realize the potential of Moon's Creed. Currently, the game includes:

- Strategic deck building system
- 3 playable heroes
- Various zodiac powers and boons
- Chaos rooms and randomly generated maps
- Modding support

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758352/853663559e2776193f303f30dfe49ad72ce24442.png

Player Feedback
Since the beginning of the development process, feedback from our player community has formed the foundation of our design. Therefore, we stay in constant communication with you through our Discord channel, evaluating your opinions on balance adjustments, narrative, and gameplay mechanics, and sharing our new content with you in advance.

Don't miss the opportunity to shape the future of the game by participating in Moon's Creed's Early Access process. Let's change the fate of the cosmos together!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758352/d15a5af50ffc65683491e5d2a35b1898dc3bbd04.png
